newsitem.title: POLAND: ING Barings sees Polish WIG at 16,500 in end 97.
newsitem.headline: ING Barings sees Polish WIG at 16,500 in end 97.

text.p: The Polish bourse's main market index, WIG, is forecast to increase to 16,500 points at the end of the year from the current 16,048 and to 20,130 at the end of 1998, ING Barings said in its June report.

The report said the market was likely to weaken in the third quarter due to large initial public offerings and parliamentary elections on September 21. But WIG will find a medium-term support at 16,000 points, it said.
"The outlook should improve significantly after the elections as issue activity slows down and non-bank corporate results reveal a trend improvement in earnings growth," the report said.
